Hi Sophie — great to hear, thanks for the clear list.

I've attached our AP onboarding packet (PDF) and a sample invoice template that maps to the PO fields you asked about. Highlights below so you can quickly pass to your AP team:

- Supplier portal fields: legal name, registered VAT/Tax ID, legal entity address, remit-to entity (if different), primary billing contact (email+phone), bank details (IBAN+SWIFT for EU remits), and certificate/EORI (if applicable).
- Minimum PO metadata for straight-through processing: PO number (mandatory), PO date, buyer legal entity, bill-to and ship-to legal entity codes (use your existing entity codes), line-level descriptions and amounts, service start/end dates (for recurring/usage), taxable indicator (Y/N), VAT rate, currency, and total gross/net.
- Invoice requirements: invoice number, invoice date, PO number reference, item code(s) if present on PO, VAT breakdown lines, and banking instructions. Our sample template includes column headers that map to your export.

Tax evidence: for EU-based buyers we typically require either:
- EU VAT registration number + EORI for cross-border shipments, or
- For UK remits, a UK VAT or EORI as applicable.

We can accept IBAN/SWIFT banking for your EU remits. For UK GBP remits, we support CHAPS/IBAN and can accept GBP payments into our UK entity. We do not accept ACH for EU invoices.

Self-billing: we can accept self-billing arrangements if your procurement/legal team issues the appropriate authorization and provides a signed self-billing agreement. Otherwise standard PO + vendor invoice flow preferred.

I'll loop in Marissa on VAT-specific evidence and Karthik for mapping file formats if your portal can export CSV/XML.

Thanks — attaching packet now.

Thanks Sophie / Ava — adding a few concrete constraints from our finance and tax teams so there are no surprises when your AP runs validation:

1) Legal entity matching: the invoice legal name must match the supplier record you create in the portal. If you need to route to a different remit entity, include the remit entity code and clear "Bill To" vs "Remit To" markers.

2) VAT/EORI: because the POs will be issued from your France entity, please capture the buyer VAT ID on the PO (buyer_vat_id) and the seller VAT/Tax ID on the invoice. If cross-border goods/services apply, include EORI on the supplier record to avoid customs retention.

3) PO lifecycle / change notices: Luminexa PO changes should include a change number (PO-CHANGE-#) and a consolidated PO revision date. Our AP matching tolerances: line-level quantity/price changes require a revised invoice referencing the change id.

4) Currency & tax handling: if the PO is EUR and remit is GBP (UK), we need exchange-rate evidence on the invoice when currency conversion is required for tax reporting. Prefer invoices in the PO currency to avoid manual adjustments.

5) Required file formats: your portal CSV export should include columns: PO_NUMBER, PO_DATE, BUYER_ENTITY_CODE, PO_LINE_ID, ITEM_CODE, DESCRIPTION, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, LINE_TAX, LINE_NET, LINE_GROSS, SERVICE_START, SERVICE_END, CURRENCY, VAT_RATE, BUYER_VAT_ID. Karthik — if they can produce UBL/Peppol rather than CSV that's great; otherwise the CSV mapping in the attached workbook should be sufficient.

6) Evidence docs to stage on the portal (we'll accept as PDF): signed W9/W-8BEN (for US entities), certified VAT registration/evidence (EU), EORI (when import/export), and proof of bank ownership (bank letter or recent bank statement masked).

I'll also share a short checklist we ask buyers to pre-fill so our vendor activation doesn't stall.

Hi Sophie — looping in technical ops on the mapping side. Quick answers:

- Net-45 is fine; we support Net-30/45/60 per contract and will honor the pilot billing terms. Early-pay discounts: yes, we can accept them — please include the discount term in the invoice (e.g., "1.5% 14 NET 45") and our AP team will apply the discount on remittance reconciliation.

- PO changes: we ingest PO-CHANGE-# in the CSV/UBL feed; please send the consolidated PO revision date and change id on the invoice as Marissa indicated. Our matching logic will accept revised invoices referencing the change id.

- PEPPOL: we support Peppol (preferred) and direct e-invoicing into our finance endpoint. If you elect Peppol, please send us the Peppol participant id and an initial test invoice to the endpoint in the mapping doc. Otherwise email PDF with the CSV mapping is acceptable.
